breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats and reinforces the exact error: it replaces A(x) with the arithmetic mean area (260 mm²) and explicitly states 'Treat A_mean as exact in the axial deformation integral,' then computes δ = PL/(A_mean·E). The ground truth requires evaluating the proper integral ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the actual varying area function, which yields a different result. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
